text: Fire protection shall follow NFPA 850 for electric generating plants and the Fire Regulation, with fire protection features per NFPA 20 (pumps), NFPA 11 (foam), NFPA 12 (CO2) and NFPA 72 (detection and alarm); the fire protection concept and the fire risk assessment (ALP-EPC-00000-HS-HAZ-0009) shall define the fire areas, the passive protection and the active systems and shall be approved before the issue of the fire water design.
